# tRPC

A Discord Activity template using **tRPC** for end-to-end type-safe APIs.

<Cards>
  <Card href="https://trpc.io/" title="tRPC" description="End-to-end type-safe APIs." />
  <Card href="/docs/plugins/trpc" title="@robojs/trpc" description="tRPC plugin for Robo.js." />
</Cards>

## Getting Started

Create a project with this template:

```package-install
npx create-robo <project-name> --template discord-activities/react-trpc-ts
```

Then navigate into your project directory:

```bash
cd <project-name>
```

Run development mode:

```bash
npm run dev
```

## Features

- tRPC pre-configured
- End-to-end type safety
- React Query integration
- TypeScript support

## How It Works

Define your API procedures in the server and call them from the client with full type safety:

<Files>
  <Folder name="src" defaultOpen disabled>
    <Folder name="app" note="Client-side code" disabled />
    <Folder name="api" note="Server routes" disabled />
  </Folder>
  <Folder name="config" defaultOpen disabled>
    <File name="vite.mjs" />
  </Folder>
  <File name=".env" />
</Files>

<Tabs items={["TypeScript", "JavaScript"]} groupId="language" persist>
  <Tab value="TypeScript">
    ```ts
    // Server
    export const appRouter = router({
      hello: publicProcedure.query(() => 'Hello, world!')
    })

    // Client
    const { data } = trpc.hello.useQuery()
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab value="JavaScript">
    ```js
    // Server
    export const appRouter = router({
      hello: publicProcedure.query(() => 'Hello, world!')
    })

    // Client
    const { data } = trpc.hello.useQuery()
    ```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>
